name: Wiki
description:
**Wiki** is a unified, in-browser interface for reading and navigating your campaign's handouts and map pins, so players and the GM stop context-switching between the Journal, the map, and individual handout windows.

## What it does

Wiki builds two automatically-managed handouts — **Wiki - GM** and **Wiki - Player** — each showing a live, two-panel interface: a navigation panel on the left and a content panel on the right. Everything is driven by clickable in-handout buttons; no macros to memorize.

### Handout Mode
- Browse any handout shared with you (or tagged `wiki+`) and jump straight to any section via its headers (H1–H4).
- Filter the navigation list to a specific header level, and optionally include subordinate headers.
- Tag sections with H5/H6 **keywords** and filter by one or more keywords at once.
- GM Notes headers appear alongside regular headers for the GM, clearly distinguished, with Notes/GM Notes content separated in the display.
- Handout-to-handout links inside your content open directly in the Wiki panel instead of a separate browser tab.

### Pin Mode
- Lists every map pin on the current page, alphabetically, with one click to view its content.
- Pin content can come from text typed directly on the pin, or from a specific section of a linked handout.
- A blockquote in linked content marks the player-visible boundary; a built-in **audit tool** (`--audit-pins`) finds player-visible pins that aren't configured correctly, with one-click fixes.
- Each pin gets quick "ping the map" buttons, for all players or GM-only.

### Search
- Full-text search across every searchable handout at once — names, headers, and body text (including GM Notes, for the GM).
- Ranked, grouped results with highlighted snippets; click straight through to the matching section.
- Results stay browsable from a persistent list while you look through multiple hits, and the matched term stays highlighted as you read.

### Navigation & sharing
- Independent Back/Forward history and Previous/Next stepping through the current filtered list, tracked separately for the GM and for players.
- One click to open a handout for editing, or to send the current content (full or player-visible version) to chat.
- Optional integration with Pintool, when installed, for enhanced pin management directly from Pin Mode.
- Set a tiled background image for the whole interface with a single tag on the Wiki Home handout.

## Getting started

1. Install the script.
2. Type `!wiki` in chat. The GM gets a link to **Wiki - GM**; players get a link to **Wiki - Player**.
3. Edit the **Wiki Home** handout (a normal handout) to build a campaign landing page — `!wiki` and the home button always return to it.
4. Use the `wiki+` and `wiki-` tags to fine-tune which handouts players can see in the Wiki, independent of Journal permissions.

Full usage details, including the keyword system and all commands, are documented in the in-app **Wiki Help** handout (`!wiki --help`).
